name: Sichuan Peanut Noodles with Charred Chicken Thigh & Cucumber Salad
description: Charred soy-marinated chicken thighs over rich sesame-peanut noodles with a cold cucumber salad.
instructions: Marinate the chicken briefly with soy, sesame oil and garlic, then char until cooked through.
Whisk sesame paste, peanut butter, soy, black vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and a splash of noodle water into a glossy sauce.
Boil the noodles and toss through the sauce.

Thinly slice the cucumber, toss with 1/4 tsp salt and leave for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Mix 1 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tsp light soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1/2 tsp sugar and 1/2 finely grated garlic clove, then toss with the cucumber just before serving and finish with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds.
Plate the noodles with the sliced chicken and cucumber salad, then finish with Sichuan pepper.
